lede: Oregon State carries the stronger underlying team rating — -2.2 against -2.5, a 0.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it UTEP +2.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Oregon State winning 55% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is depth, where Oregon State leads UTEP by 99 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 73% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
